title: Untitled 2
body:
i don't know when but my left shoe just left
recently. i'm not sure where it fell to, but it
must've been a thousand kilograms of steel
or something because nowadays i feel like a
hot air balloon.

now that i think of it, my right foot just
doesn't seem right. it's light as a flame and
forces me to be more flexible than i've ever
been. a kilogram of feathers. i don't do
ballet. hell i don't even do yoga. but as long
as it's lifting the air in my balloon of a head,
it's smooth sailing.

the view from up here is amazing. it fills my
chest with menthol and thyme. my ears with
rattling fall leaves. my stomach with chicken
katsu curry.

i will admit. i'm half expecting the flame to
burn through the shoelace wick and go out
any minute. then i'll just be a sheet of
canvas with a wicker basket ass and no
shoes. at least my feet wouldn't be cold for
long.
